name: Lien Lei
source:
Cyborg

CEO of Seon Corp and Angel’s boss who has a famous storm-like temper. He may or may not have feelings for her…

Lien has had a grudge against family members for years which he might take to the grave.

[From [url=http://altabestudio.com/works/ea-pinocchio/]official site[/url]]
